parent_objective: Finish the already-open EA Video Gaming preference prompt live certification without changing its current game/save. Only after independently reviewed completion advise the oldest authorized disposable lab save for later standardized certifications.

active_certification.source: docs/PREFERENCE_PROMPTS.md and open PR #263; current local Windows state and ignored receipts are not readable through GitHub
active_certification.blocking_condition: Do not promote previous Yes/No or rollback receipts to current open-dialog completion without reviewer-verified current offer outcome, native effect, rollback, and review refs

negative_controls: No local memo => abstain with no save side effect
Game running on an operator-pending certification => no save change or restart
No running game => only bound pinned lab save advisory, never automatic load
Failed/missing certification review => no general age-based ranking
Age ranking remains canonical and advisory after reviewed completion; no independent cert claimed
Branch PR #263 and ignored local observer remain untouched

household_successor_route.guard: Same freshly observed household in the reviewed certification and its successor; exact current build and distinct successor run
household_successor_route.candidate: Oldest attested current-run LAB_DISPOSABLE save with confirmed household binding
household_successor_route.host_execution: Requires existing live adapter, exact menu/slot revalidation and separate player-first effect admission
household_successor_route.ordinary_play: Existing household and recent saves stay player-owned until a separately certified route is adopted

repeat_offer_reuse.required_basis: Previously reviewed same mechanic, build and household; original completion references remain intact
repeat_offer_reuse.capture_rule: Distinct repeat instance capture and review references; no historical PID matching
repeat_offer_reuse.proof: Historical native certification plus visible current resolution; never relabel as new native telemetry
repeat_offer_reuse.successor: Use the same-household successor route only
